records.name: Inspect bounded runtime and effect observations
records.outcome: Enable an operator/reviewer to inspect source- and runtime-identity-bound traces, transitions and effect observations without promoting fixtures or metadata into production truth.
acceptance_conditions: The supported input, selected source/profile/tool and exact result scope are identified.
Existing runtime observations, invocation traces and original source/profile graphs; redaction, exact subjects and observation scope remain explicit.
Unsupported, stale, unknown or out-of-scope results remain explicit; no inferred runtime or owner authority.
exclusions: Universal support or full lifecycle completion beyond the selected source path
Fresh runtime/provider/whole-product value qualification from this proposal
Implicit ownership transfer, admission, publication or deployment
owner_routes: implementation: Existing component owners named by realization bindings

records.name: Qualify bounded behavior and application quality
records.outcome: Enable reviewers to retain explicit denominators and reproducible selected checks for application behavior, recipe/runtime expectations and model-dependent quality.
acceptance_conditions: The supported input, selected source/profile/tool and exact result scope are identified.
Existing finite behavioral/recipe/application quality paths and recorded fixture metrics; scoped historical performance reports and examples are not universal performance or real-model claims.
Unsupported, stale, unknown or out-of-scope results remain explicit; no inferred runtime or owner authority.
exclusions: Universal support or full lifecycle completion beyond the selected source path
Fresh runtime/provider/whole-product value qualification from this proposal
Implicit ownership transfer, admission, publication or deployment
owner_routes: implementation: Existing component owners named by realization bindings
